newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 4.1 pct vs. year ago--EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 4.1 pct vs. year ago--EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 61.401 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended Nov 30, up 4.1 percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said.
The amount of power supplied to the Pacific Northwest area rose the most from a year ago, up 14.5 percent to 3,676 GWh, EEI said.
In the Southwest, electricity output fell 2.0 percent from a year ago to 4,341 GWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 3.05 million GWh, up 2.4 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
